turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: two systems today, rear lot condenser first

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: downstairs is set at seventy four, but it hasn't kept up by mid afternoon

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: coil face isn't blocked, that's good

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: head three twelve

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: capacitance on the compressor side is twenty one microfarads

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: nameplate says thirty five, that's weak

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: i'd change the cap before we chase charge

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: yes, do that

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: disconnect is out, old cap is off

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: replacement's mounted and wired, everything tight

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: thirty four point seven on the new one

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: rear system sounds smoother now, no chatter

turns.speaker: device
turns.text: reading back, capacitor thirty four point seven on the rear condenser--

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: sorry, one more thing, filter grille's in the hallway

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: first floor air handler, airflow feels pretty even at the grilles

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: supply fifty eight

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: actually fifty seven at the supply, probe was against the cabinet

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: pan's holding water, i'll clear the condensate line

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: go ahead, it's dripped before

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: vac's on the drain, pulling the blockage

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: line's flowing, calling that clear

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: hold it, water backed up when the blower restarted, still a plug

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: pulled the trap apart and flushed it, drains freely now

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: loading dock condenser next

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: fan's louder than the other one, can hear it from here

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: fan draw is two point three, or three point two, this clamp's dancing

effects.answer: three point two when the lead settles

turns.speaker: device
turns.text: which value was it?

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: three point two when the lead settles

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: i grabbed the wrong photo, that head pressure three twelve was from this unit, not rear

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: fan's got a grinding sound even though cooling's on

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: i'd replace that fan motor before it locks up

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: do it if you've got one on the truck

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: power's off and old motor is out

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: new motor bracket's not lining up, won't force it

turns.speaker: device
turns.text: you haven't logged a filter check yet

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: i've secured the leads and left the disconnect off, motor job stays open

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: mezzanine air handler, grilles are rattling a little

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: there's lint caught at the bottom of the coil

turns.speaker: tech
turns.text: coil looks dusty, suggest cleaning at the next service

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: no, not the cleaning, we've only approved the motor
